title: Towards Evaluation of Autonomously Generated Musical Compositions: A Comprehensive Survey
reasoning: The paper is a survey on how to evaluate autonomously generated music, which inherently involves discussing subjective concepts like creativity, aesthetics, and the value of art. It questions the benefit and purpose of AI creating art, which are philosophical and value-laden inquiries central to the paper's theme. The discussion extends beyond purely technical or objective measures to include subjective human perception and the definition of creativity itself, touching upon epistemological and aesthetic dimensions that are related to the broader category of ethics and values. For instance, it discusses what value a composition by a 'dead author' brings and explores definitions of creativity that touch on spirituality (e.g., a connection 'between heaven and earth').
